name: PHPStan Typecheck on Edit
description: Runs PHPStan static analysis after agent writes a PHP file. Exit code 2 blocks the agent with feedback.

then.command: wsl -d Ubuntu-22.04 -- bash -c "cd /home/user/10x-project && ./vendor/bin/sail php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M --no-progress 2>&1; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then exit 2; fi"
